modules.name: ontologylab.calibration
modules.rationale: Fits isotonic/ECE maps of extractor confidence onto review outcomes; annotates the queue and never rewrites stored confidences.

modules.name: ontologylab.citation
modules.rationale: Thin savepoint facade over citation bind/store; the live citation receipt API used at extract-write and review grounding.

secondary_stages.why: run_extraction persists chunk citations in the same write as proposed facts — Extract→Verify shortcut.

modules.name: ontologylab.citation_bind
modules.rationale: Builds CitationBinding rows from one extracted chunk; a real construct-vs-verify cut versus citation_verify.

secondary_stages.why: Only called from persist_chunk_citations during extraction, not from the human-review path.

hidden_fallbacks.what: persist_once returns () when _load_context finds no extraction chunk receipt — citations silently omitted instead of refusing.

modules.name: ontologylab.citation_ids
modules.rationale: Content-addressed citation_receipt_id/fact_revision_id; mechanical ids slice of the citation concern (60 LOC), not its own stage.

modules.name: ontologylab.citation_schema
modules.rationale: DDL+append-only triggers for citation_receipts; mechanical schema slice (61 LOC) of citation Verify, not a separate infra stage.

secondary_stages.why: ensure_* is a storage adapter, but it exists only to persist Verify receipts.

modules.name: ontologylab.citation_store
modules.rationale: Caller-owned put/get/list of citation receipts after verify_binding; 202 LOC store slice sitting under the ~250 cap.

secondary_stages.why: SQLite insert path is storage, not a second transformation.

modules.name: ontologylab.citation_types
modules.rationale: Typed boundary for citation receipts/bindings/refusals; the only citation split that is a real contract rather than a LOC cut.

modules.name: ontologylab.citation_verify
modules.rationale: Checks bindings against ready Representation bytes/hashes/spans; the verify half of the bind/verify pair (240 LOC, at the cap).

modules.name: ontologylab.communities
modules.rationale: Partitions the verified subgraph and writes pack-time community summaries (Leiden or label-propagation + extractive/LLM summary).

secondary_stages.why: Invoked from pack build, not from Extract/Verify; communities are sealed into the pack.

hidden_fallbacks.what: community_algorithm() silently reports label_propagation when leidenalg/igraph are missing; detect_communities(algorithm='auto') at :107 uses that.
LLM summarizer exception or None fails open to extractive_summary; pack records method extractive without a failed-LLM flag.

modules.name: ontologylab.competency
modules.rationale: Frozen Q1/Q2/Q3 release-gate that runs extract→review→pack→query against gold fixtures; a whole-pipeline mega-check, not one stage.

secondary_stages.why: Q2 drives parse_and_validate_extraction through a hardcoded MockEngine.
Q3 builds a pack via packbuilder.build_pack.

hidden_fallbacks.what: Always constructs MockEngine(); no get_engine slot — mock is not a caller choice.

modules.name: ontologylab.conformal
modules.rationale: Split-conformal τ from critic scores on rejected items; badges the review queue and has no path to a status change.

modules.name: ontologylab.critic
modules.rationale: Second-engine advisory plausibility scores into critic_reviews; sorts/flags the queue and never approves or rejects.

hidden_fallbacks.what: CLI `ontologylab critic --engine` defaults to mock (hidden CamelCase scorer on real proposals unless overridden).
resolve_critic_model substitutes CRITIC_MODEL (Haiku-class) when engine_name=='claude' and no explicit model.
engine/parse failure fails open: batch skipped, stats.batches_failed++, loop continues.

engine_slot.interface: Engine.generate (resolved by get_engine at callers; critic_review takes an already-built engine)

modules.name: ontologylab.embeddings
modules.rationale: Embedder protocol + hashing/MiniLM backends for hybrid search (and merge cosine); a retrieval engine adapter, not Extract.

secondary_stages.why: scan_merge_candidates uses cosine/unpack_vector as one ER signal.
Embedder is a nameable engine adapter reused across Consume and Resolve.

hidden_fallbacks.what: get_embedder('auto') falls back to HashingEmbedder (lexical n-gram proxy) when sentence-transformers is missing or the offline load fails.

modules.name: ontologylab.enrichment
modules.rationale: Looks up verified nodes in curated resources and queues annotation proposals; no LLM get_engine path.

secondary_stages.why: Default lookup_fn is connectors.resources.lookup (network fetch of registry records).

hidden_fallbacks.what: Missing annotations table is swallowed (except Exception → empty decided set) so enrichment proceeds on predating stores.
Per-resource lookup exceptions are recorded and skipped rather than failing the pass.

modules.name: ontologylab.evaluation
modules.rationale: Gold-file triple P/R/F1 of store extractions; CLI measurement harness, not a live pipeline stage.

modules.name: ontologylab.expansion
modules.rationale: LLM lexical query variants composed into FTS5 MATCH; vocab-listed Synthesize, actually invoked on the Consume search path.

secondary_stages.why: Callers are search (CLI --expand, MCP semantic_search_expanded), not Extract/Synthesize of the graph.

hidden_fallbacks.what: engine.generate or parse failure returns ([], usage_with_error) — search continues on the raw query.
CLI `ontologylab search --engine` defaults to mock when --expand is set.

modules.name: ontologylab.extraction_receipt_ids
modules.rationale: SHA-256 plan/run/chunk receipt ids; mechanical ids slice, also imported as a hash helper by citation_ids and selection_ids.

modules.name: ontologylab.extraction_receipt_schema
modules.rationale: DDL for extraction_run/chunk receipts; mechanical 74-LOC schema cut of one persist-receipts concern.

secondary_stages.why: ensure_receipt_schema is storage DDL, not a second transformation.

modules.name: ontologylab.extraction_receipt_store
modules.rationale: Immutable put_once of run/chunk receipts against ready bytes; 240 LOC — the 250-cap store cut of extraction_receipts.

modules.name: ontologylab.extraction_receipt_types
modules.rationale: Typed ExtractionRunBinding/ChunkSpan/receipt set; real typed boundary of the otherwise mechanical receipt split.

modules.name: ontologylab.extraction_receipts
modules.rationale: 45-LOC savepoint facade over receipt schema+store; no additional transformation beyond put_extraction_receipts.

modules.name: ontologylab.extraction_state
modules.rationale: SQLite run/chunk lifecycle (plan/claim/succeed/fail) plus re-export of put_extraction_receipts.

secondary_stages.why: ensure_schema also installs citation_schema and grounded_review_schema — Extract owning Verify DDL.

modules.name: ontologylab.extractor
modules.rationale: Chunk/prompt/parse/validate/run loop that writes ProposedEntity/Relation; 930-LOC mega-module and the Extract engine insertion point.

secondary_stages.why: persist_chunk_citations runs inside the extract write, not after a Verify stage boundary.

hidden_fallbacks.what: _locate falls through to alphanumeric-skeleton matching when the token regex misses.
Relation endpoints naming un-emitted entities mint synthesized=True placeholders, even with no source span.
EngineError on a chunk is logged and skipped (continue); the run does not fail closed.

modules.name: ontologylab.grounded_review
modules.rationale: Live append-only ReviewDecision API (apply_review / waiver); 255 LOC facade that still contains _apply/_waive business logic.

modules.name: ontologylab.grounded_review_ids
modules.rationale: review_decision_id / build_decision hashing; mechanical ids slice, also used by pack_receipt_seal.

secondary_stages.why: Pack seal recomputes historical_review_decision_id from the same formula.

modules.name: ontologylab.grounded_review_members
modules.rationale: Loads stored member citations for a review item; 86-LOC mechanical slice of apply_review preflight.

modules.name: ontologylab.grounded_review_payload
modules.rationale: Serializes ReviewDecision to machine_receipt/batch_payload dicts; 62-LOC mechanical slice of the facade.

modules.name: ontologylab.grounded_review_preflight
modules.rationale: Loads members, requires citations, asserts legal transitions before a decision is written — a real gate inside the mechanical family.

modules.name: ontologylab.grounded_review_schema
modules.rationale: DDL for grounded_review_decisions/current plus append-only triggers; mechanical 74-LOC schema cut.

secondary_stages.why: KGStore.open also ensure_grounded_review_schema — storage mega-module reaching into Verify DDL.

modules.name: ontologylab.grounded_review_store
modules.rationale: Persist/list/current pointer for ReviewDecision rows; 244 LOC store cut at the 250 cap.

modules.name: ontologylab.grounded_review_types
modules.rationale: ReviewAction/ReviewDecision/WaiverRequest typed boundary; the real contract of the grounded_review family.

modules.name: ontologylab.intent
modules.rationale: Chat-sentence classifier over a fixed ACTIONS table; uses the Extract engine slot but is a Consume surface, not graph extraction.

secondary_stages.why: Same Engine.generate contract as extractor; MockEngine routes on INTENT_MARKER_OPEN.

hidden_fallbacks.what: Any engine exception becomes Intent('unknown') rather than failing the request.

modules.name: ontologylab.merge
modules.rationale: Blocked fuzzy duplicate scan that only proposes merge_candidates for a human; entity-resolution, not Extract/Verify.

secondary_stages.why: Pairs land in a human merge/dismiss queue; the scanner itself does not merge.

modules.name: ontologylab.proposals
modules.rationale: 1229-LOC mega-module: extraction rows → content-addressed OntologyProposal artifacts, plus human verify_ontology_proposal apply.

secondary_stages.why: verify_ontology_proposal applies a proposal only with explicit human verification metadata.

modules.name: ontologylab.rerankers
modules.rationale: Optional cross-encoder over the RRF shortlist; retrieval engine adapter with silent auto→None degradation.

secondary_stages.why: Reranker protocol is a replaceable engine adapter for Consume search.

hidden_fallbacks.what: get_reranker('auto') returns None on any load failure; caller keeps RRF order with no error.

modules.name: ontologylab.research_extract
modules.rationale: Research-run consumer: F9-select ready Representation, bind Task-2 receipts, then run_extraction — three stages in one function.

secondary_stages.why: put_selection_receipt chooses the Work's preferred ready full text before any LLM call.
attach_explicit_completeness_variants calls ingest_item to persist abstract/full-text siblings.

engine_slot.interface: SupportsGenerate.generate on ResearchExtractSession.engine (get_engine at jobs.py, not here)

modules.name: ontologylab.review_decision
modules.rationale: Unreachable parallel review-decision facade (inventory.unreachable); duplicates grounded_review apply/waiver/preflight.

secondary_stages.why: Would be the Verify decision API if anything imported it; nothing in main/server/mcp does.

modules.name: ontologylab.review_decision_ids
modules.rationale: Unreachable hashing for review_decision_id/batch_id; mechanical ids of the dead review_decision pipeline.

secondary_stages.why: Same identity concern as grounded_review_ids.review_decision_id.

modules.name: ontologylab.review_decision_schema
modules.rationale: Unreachable DDL for review_decisions; mechanical schema of the dead pipeline (tests-only importer).

secondary_stages.why: Would persist Verify decisions; no entrypoint reaches ensure_review_decision_schema.

modules.name: ontologylab.review_decision_store
modules.rationale: Unreachable put/list of review_decisions rows; store slice of the dead duplicate pipeline.

secondary_stages.why: Mirrors grounded_review_store.persist_decision.

modules.name: ontologylab.review_decision_types
modules.rationale: Unreachable DecisionKind/ReviewDecision types; parallel typed boundary to grounded_review_types.

secondary_stages.why: Second ReviewDecision dataclass overlapping grounded_review_types.ReviewDecision.

modules.name: ontologylab.review_grounding
modules.rationale: Unreachable classify_member over citation receipts or legacy spans; dead twin of grounded_review_preflight.require_grounding.

secondary_stages.why: Grounding classification belongs in Verify; only review_decision imports it.

hidden_fallbacks.what: _legacy_grounding_tokens accepts pre-receipt span tokens so uncited facts can still classify as grounded.

modules.name: ontologylab.selection
modules.rationale: F9 preferred-Representation receipt facade (put/get/list); Work/Representation identity, not human review — vocab 'selection' under Verify is a name collision.

secondary_stages.why: Only production caller is extract_research_documents, which treats selection as an Extract pre-step.

modules.name: ontologylab.selection_ids
modules.rationale: selection_receipt_id / inventory JSON; mechanical ids slice of F9 selection.

modules.name: ontologylab.selection_policy
modules.rationale: Ranks Representation candidates (ready/full-text/grade/source/stage) and select_winner — the only real policy boundary in the selection_* split.

hidden_fallbacks.what: PolicyVersion.V1 returns None unless usable_full_text_rank==0 (no eligible ready full text), which research_extract then raises as SelectionRefused.

modules.name: ontologylab.selection_schema
modules.rationale: DDL for preferred-selection receipts; mechanical 41-LOC schema cut.

secondary_stages.why: ensure_selection_schema is storage DDL.

modules.name: ontologylab.selection_store
modules.rationale: put_once computes inventory via policy and inserts an immutable selection receipt; 131-LOC store slice.

modules.name: ontologylab.selection_types
modules.rationale: PolicyVersion/RepresentationCandidate/SelectionReceipt typed boundary for F9 selection.

modules.name: ontologylab.semantic_staleness
modules.rationale: Deterministic verified-fact fingerprints and pack baseline marker; consumed again at MCP to compute deltas.

secondary_stages.why: MCP imports baseline_compatible/semantic_deltas to compare a live store against a packed baseline.

findings: Extract slot is injected, not owned: none of extractor/research_extract/intent/critic/expansion/enrichment/communities call get_engine (ontologylab/engines.py:890). Call sites that feed those stages: ontologylab/main.py:644 (extract CLI), ontologylab/server/jobs.py:731 (extract job), ontologylab/server/jobs.py:1094 (research_extract), ontologylab/main.py:1052 (critic CLI), ontologylab/server/routes.py:1301 (POST /critic/run), ontologylab/main.py:1507 (search --expand), ontologylab/mcp_server.py:821 (semantic_search_expanded), ontologylab/server/routes.py:2345 (chat classify), ontologylab/main.py:1312 (communities llm_summarizer). enrichment.py has no get_engine path (lookup_fn at ontologylab/enrichment.py:135).

Engine name defaults to mock at CLI critic (ontologylab/main.py:1999) and CLI search-expand (ontologylab/main.py:2165); method-compiler extract also defaults mock (ontologylab/main.py:398). HTTP extract/critic/chat default paths.DEFAULT_ENGINE claude (ontologylab/server/schemas.py:83, ontologylab/server/schemas.py:299, ontologylab/server/schemas.py:399; ontologylab/paths.py:20). ontologylab extract CLI defaults claude (ontologylab/main.py:1868). ontologylab/competency.py:142 hardcodes MockEngine() with no slot. MockEngine itself is selected only when name=='mock' (ontologylab/engines.py:913) and then silently routes by prompt markers (ontologylab/engines.py:506).

Family splits are mostly mechanical ~250-LOC cuts of one concern, not stage boundaries. citation_* wc-l: citation 84 + bind 257 + ids 60 + schema 61 + store 202 + types 104 + verify 240 = 1008 (real cut: bind vs verify; rest types/ids/schema/store/facade). extraction_receipt_* : receipts 45 + ids 99 + schema 74 + store 240 + types 90 = 548 (store sits at 240; facade is a savepoint re-export). grounded_review_* : facade 255 + ids 149 + members 86 + payload 62 + preflight 206 + schema 74 + store 244 + types 133 = 1209 (store 244 / facade 255 at the cap; members+payload are apply_review slices; preflight is a real gate). review_decision_* + review_grounding: 215+84+69+180+87+174 = 809, same pattern, unreachable. selection_* : facade 53 + ids 116 + policy 213 + schema 41 + store 131 + types 130 = 684 (policy/select_winner is a real ranking boundary; the rest is mechanical).

review_decision + review_decision_ids + review_decision_schema + review_decision_store + review_decision_types + review_grounding are inventory.json unreachable (orphan) and duplicate the live grounded_review* Verify path used by ontologylab/kgstore.py:3089 _grounded_review. Overlapping flows: two ReviewDecision types (ontologylab/grounded_review_types.py:48 vs ontologylab/review_decision_types.py:62) and two review_decision_id functions (ontologylab/grounded_review_ids.py:43 vs ontologylab/review_decision_ids.py:61).

critic/calibration/conformal/evaluation are parked advisory math, not a transforming Verify stage. ontologylab/critic.py:11: no code path from a score to a status change; wired CLI ontologylab/main.py:1049 and POST ontologylab/server/routes.py:1297. calibration_report is GET /review/calibration (ontologylab/server/routes.py:428) and never rewrites confidences (ontologylab/calibration.py:24-26). conformal triage is GET /review/triage (ontologylab/server/routes.py:412) with the same no-approve boundary (ontologylab/conformal.py:16-19). evaluation.evaluate_store is CLI-only ontologylab/main.py:1090 — absent from server/mcp. competency.run_competency_suite is a separate HTTP/CLI gold gate (ontologylab/server/routes.py:2707) overlapping evaluation.

Mega-modules and cross-stage shortcuts violate one-transformation-per-stage: proposals.py 1229 LOC mixes build_ontology_proposals:724 (Extract) with verify_ontology_proposal:1107 (Verify). extractor.py 930 LOC chunks, prompts, parses, writes facts, and persist_chunk_citations at ontologylab/extractor.py:898 (Extract→Verify). research_extract.extract_research_documents:133 calls ingest_item:110 (Acquire/Normalize), put_selection_receipt:148 (Normalize), put_extraction_receipts via _bind_run_receipt:190, then run_extraction:159. extraction_state.ensure_schema:133 installs citation + grounded_review schemas from an Extract module.

Two Extract entrypoints: run_extraction (ontologylab/extractor.py:718) used by CLI/jobs extract, versus extract_research_documents (ontologylab/research_extract.py:133) used by the research job (ontologylab/server/jobs.py:1094). Duplicated routing into the same engine.generate loop.

selection_* implements F9 preferred-Representation identity (Normalize) despite canonical Verify vocabulary listing 'selection'. Production insertion is ontologylab/research_extract.py:144 before any LLM call. Fan-in split: selection.py/store reachable from server only; selection_ids/policy/schema/types also from main/mcp via pack seal.

Hidden algorithm fallbacks outside mock: communities community_algorithm auto→label_propagation (ontologylab/communities.py:57, ontologylab/communities.py:107); embeddings get_embedder('auto')→HashingEmbedder lexical proxy (ontologylab/embeddings.py:234); rerankers get_reranker('auto')→None (ontologylab/rerankers.py:104); extractor span relocate + synthesized endpoints (ontologylab/extractor.py:442, ontologylab/extractor.py:563); citation_bind persist_once returns () when Task-2 receipts are missing (ontologylab/citation_bind.py:38).

intent is Consume (chat ACTIONS classifier at ontologylab/intent.py:184) sharing the Extract Engine.generate slot; expansion is invoked on Consume search but vocab-classified Synthesize; embeddings/rerankers are Consume engine adapters. The Extract slot is therefore a generic LLM adapter reused across Extract/Verify/Synthesize/Consume rather than a nameable per-stage contract.
